description:
Read a comment in which the account was @mentioned, by comment ID.

Meta provides no endpoint that lists mentions — they are delivered to your app through the "mentions" webhook field, and this tool reads one once you have its ID. If you have no webhook configured, you cannot discover mentions through the API at all.

Reply with instagram_reply_to_mention.

account_id.description: Instagram professional account ID. Omit to use the token's own account.

comment_id.description: Comment ID from a mentions webhook payload

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: instagram_get_mentioned_comment
title: Get Mentioned Comment
